about: With an uplifting array of alternative RnB, global club sounds and leftfield electronica.

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 21 Dec. Jamz digs into Collected Rips 2004-2024, a compilation from Brazilian funk collective Weird Baile on Colombian label TraTraTrax. It gathers years of their SoundCloud cult cuts that were never officially released, remastered from MP3 rips, voice notes and lost project files. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: with Joe Cotch on Weird Baile

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 14 Dec. Jamz is joined on the show by Austrian, Barcelona-based producer and DJ Zora Jones to talk about her new album, 50 Bullets to the Heart. It's out now on her own label, Bellyfat, and it's her first album since 2020's Ten Billion Angels. This time her voice is up front, over Miami bass, Jersey club, grime and R&B. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music
items.title: with Zora Jones

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 7 Dec. Jamz is joined by Lenna Bahule, the Mozambican vocalist, composer and body percussionist whose music moves between Mozambique, Brazil and the wider Afro diaspora, often sung in African and imagined languages. Following her first UK tour this autumn, she speaks on her album KUMLANGO, which takes its name from the Jaua word for "portal", and Do Leste em Diante, her new live show built on research into transatlantic musical connections. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music
items.title: with Lenna Bahule

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 23 Nov. Jamz is joined by Norsicaa, the Malaysian-Australian DJ and selector who ran Soundway Records for eight years before setting up her own label, Sama Sama Records. She speaks on the label’s focus on reissues and overlooked music from the Asia-Pacific... Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music
items.title: with Norsicaa
